g.text: Epoch-end checkpoint proxies | after all updates in the labelled epoch
These proxy states come from archived epoch-end weights, not first-batch pre-optimizer snapshots in Figures 07-08. Epoch 0 denotes initialization if supplied. Cycle observations are incomplete runs.
